recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to light gray (#E8E8E8) and add a thin gray hairline border around the outer canvas.
2. Place a dark-gray (#2C3E50) rectangular header band across the top 0-18% of the slide.
3. Inside the header band, add centered white (#FFFFFF) title text: "Non-Linearly Separable Data".
4. At the top-right of the header band, place a pale-yellow (#F39C12) circular badge containing the number "17" in dark-gray (#2C3E50) text.
5. Directly below the header band (top 18-25%), add a red (#E74C3C) italic instruction line with the exact text: Each Sample is represented by two features "x" and "y".
6. In the center region (25-88% height), draw a chart pane with a dark-red (#E74C3C) hairline border.
7. Inside the chart pane, draw a red (#E74C3C) x-axis and a red (#E74C3C) y-axis with arrowheads crossing at the center; label them "x" and "y" in black (#000000) text.
8. Plot red (#E74C3C) and cyan (#1ABC9C) circular scatter points inside the chart pane.
9. Draw a red (#E74C3C) circular decision boundary centered at the origin of the axes.
10. Draw a blue (#3498DB) straight diagonal line decision boundary across the chart pane.
11. On the right side (70-95% width), place two light-blue callout boxes with #3498DB borders: one containing the text "Linear Decision Boundary" with a leader line to the blue diagonal line, and one containing the text "Non-Linear Decision Boundary" with a leader line to the red circle.
12. Add a black (#000000) rectangular footer strip across the bottom of the slide.
